core_obligations: Derive condition (2) from affineness of j by the unit-ideal and colimit argument (proof lines 7569-7585).
Reduce the converse to X local with closed point x, using flat base change and the cohomology of the inclusion (proof lines 7587-7614).
Handle the cases x in U and dim 0, then run the induction on the dimension (proof lines 7615-7631).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the situation of the structure sheaf lemma, the inclusion j : U -> X of the locus where a section s of a rank 1 reflexive module is an isomorphism is affine if and only if for every x outside U some power s^n lies in m_x F^{[n]}_x (source lines 7558-7567). For the forward direction the proof pulls U back to Spec(O_{X,x}), uses that it is affine and misses x so that the maximal ideal generates the unit ideal, writes 1 = sum f_i g_i and lifts through the colimit presentation of the sections. The converse is a local cohomology argument: after reducing to an affine base and a local ring, vanishing of the higher direct images is proved by induction on the dimension, using the displayed expression for 1.
